expect: reject: core spec §7.2 — "A manifest's producer `keys` array is the complete producer-key snapshot effective from that manifest's entry index: it discards the prior snapshot". Manifest v2 at entry 23 declares only producer-1, so producer-2 — added by the `key` statement at entry 9 — is not in the key set as of any entry index at or after 23. The Ed25519 signature is mathematically valid; the key is simply no longer entitled to make it.
name: signed-by-dropped-producer-key
